# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version deployed on [quran.com](https://quran.com) (the `production` branch) is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please **do not** open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, report it privately using GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) feature:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/quran/quran.com-frontend-next/security) of this repository.
2. Click "Report a vulnerability" to open a draft security advisory.
3. Provide as much detail as possible (steps to reproduce, affected versions, potential impact).

We will review the report and respond as soon as possible.
